PullRequest.Title: sessions: Align compact session twistie
PullRequest.Body:
## Summary

- align the nested-chat twistie with compact session row content
- add a compact twistie component screenshot fixture for dark and light themes
- add a geometry regression test for the twistie and status-icon centers

## Validation

- `npm run compile`
- `npm run hygiene`
- `cd test/componentFixtures/playwright && npm test -- sessionsListTwistie.spec.ts`
- `cd test/componentFixtures/playwright && npx tsc --noEmit`
- `npm run eslint -- src/vs/workbench/test/browser/componentFixtures/sessions/sessionsList.fixture.ts test/componentFixtures/playwright/tests/sessionsListTwistie.spec.ts`
- component screenshots reviewed in dark and light themes

Scenarios.Scenario: Rendering and hovering a compact Sessions list containing sessions with nested chats
Scenarios.CriticalPath: SessionsList materializes the visible tree rows, then the browser matches the compact descendant selector and uses the overridden static `top` value during normal style/layout. Hover still changes twistie opacity and pointer events through pre-existing rules; the diff adds no script, geometry read, or extra relayout loop to the interaction path.
Scenarios.ScalingInput: Number of currently materialized compact list rows with a nested-chat twistie, rather than the total number of sessions; the selector performs no collection traversal in JavaScript.
Scenarios.EffectiveConcurrency: Single browser main-thread style/layout pass for the currently materialized list rows; list virtualization bounds work to visible rows, and the change adds no scheduler, queue, or asynchronous fan-out.
Scenarios.CacheBehavior: The stylesheet is loaded and parsed with the existing sessions CSS; cold load adds one declaration and warm interactions reuse the parsed stylesheet. No application cache key, miss path, coalescing, or negative cache is changed.
Scenarios.MechanismConfidence: High confidence that the only production change is a static CSS `top` override. Surrounding rules already absolutely position the twistie and already perform the hover visibility transition, so no new forced-layout mechanism exists.
Scenarios.MagnitudeUncertainty: Exact style-recalculation cost depends on the visible row count and browser engine, but a single static property override under an existing compact container is constant work per materialized twistie and does not establish measurable user-visible degradation.
Scenarios.Verdict: No reportable regression. The diff only changes the computed vertical offset of existing absolutely positioned elements and neither increases event frequency nor adds layout reads/writes, retained state, or expensive boundaries.

Scenarios.Scenario: Generating the new compact-twistie fixture and running the added Playwright geometry test
Scenarios.CriticalPath: Fixture selection renders an existing mocked SessionsList once, performs three bounded DOM lookups, and sets two inline style properties. The new Playwright test then performs one local fixture navigation, one hover, visibility synchronization, and two geometry reads before one assertion; all are test-only and not on an end-user product path.

ExpensiveBoundaries.Operation: Navigates the Playwright page to the local component-explorer HTTP URL and waits for the fixture DOM.
ExpensiveBoundaries.Cardinality: One local page navigation for the newly added geometry test invocation.
ExpensiveBoundaries.PreviousBehavior: This geometry test and its one local navigation did not exist before the diff; existing tests already used the same helper independently.
ExpensiveBoundaries.CriticalPathEffect: The test cannot inspect geometry until the local page load and fixture render complete; this affects only the component test's runtime.

ExpensiveBoundaries.Operation: Requests two element bounding boxes through Playwright's browser automation channel, synchronizing with rendered geometry.
ExpensiveBoundaries.Cardinality: Exactly two sequential geometry requests in the newly added test, independent of session collection size.
ExpensiveBoundaries.PreviousBehavior: The prior file did not request these compact-row bounding boxes.
ExpensiveBoundaries.CriticalPathEffect: Both requests must complete before the assertion, adding bounded test-only latency.

Scenarios.ScalingInput: A fixed two-session fixture and two geometry reads; themed screenshot coverage scales by the fixture framework's default dark/light variants, not by user data or runtime list size.
Scenarios.EffectiveConcurrency: Operations inside each test are sequentially awaited. The added test creates one bounded browser page workflow; the themed fixture defines the standard dark/light variants but adds no unbounded scheduling or aggregate concurrency mechanism.
Scenarios.CacheBehavior: The fixture uses in-memory mocked services and fixed session data, with no changed application cache. Browser asset caching across tests is runner-dependent, but the added workflow performs only one bounded local navigation and does not introduce retries or miss amplification.
Scenarios.MechanismConfidence: High confidence in the bounded test-only browser work because the new test directly calls `openFixture` once and `boundingBox` twice; high confidence that fixture rendering uses mocked services and fixed data, with no filesystem, database, subprocess, or external network call in the changed render branch.
Scenarios.MagnitudeUncertainty: The exact CI duration of local navigation and screenshot fixture enumeration depends on the runner, but the work is bounded to one small geometry test plus the standard fixture variants and is intentional regression coverage rather than product-path overhead.
Scenarios.Verdict: No reportable performance issue. The added browser automation and fixture rendering impose small, fixed test-suite cost and do not affect shipped product latency, throughput, memory, or rendering responsiveness.

Analysis.Summary: Completed the performance pass over all three changed files and every diff page. The production change is a static positioning override with no new hot-path work; the remaining changes add bounded component-fixture and Playwright coverage. No actionable, diff-introduced product performance regression was found.
